chose: The owner's fast-track is an append-only record, voice_note_fast_track (subject_id, note_id, n, act fast|cancel, acted_at): one row per act, the newest act deciding, a repeat of the newest act writing nothing; an update aborts, and rows go with the note and with the account.
options: a mutable flag on the note
gray: Nothing is ever edited, so how often the owner marks and takes back stays visible; reads pick the newest act.
undo: Stop reading it: drop the urgency CASE's marked term and the route. Keep the table and its rows, which are the owner's record.
